text:
Noah: Hi all — I'm putting in my resignation today. Last day proposed: 2024-07-03. Please start offboarding steps. Need confirmation on benefits cutoff, COBRA timing, passport/visa doc handoff (Im on a dependent visa), and how to return my company hardware (laptop + YubiKey).
Priya (People Ops): Sorry to hear you're leaving, Noah. Quick rundown: benefits stop end-of-day on 2024-07-03. COBRA packet will be sent by mail/email within 14 business days after that date; election window typically 60 days. We'll include carrier contacts and estimated premiums. For visa paperwork, People Ops/Legal will prepare the employment verification letter if needed.
Noah: Thanks. For the verification letter, I need dates of employment and last salary in a specific format for the immigration office. Can Priya coordinate with Legal?
Priya (People Ops): Yep — I'll loop in Legal and send the standard verification template. Expect a draft in 2 business days.
IT-bot: Please confirm asset details to issue a pre-paid return label. We'll schedule a secure wipe after final day unless manager requests earlier.
```
asset_tag: RDN-05789
device: MacBook Air 13"
serial: SN-A1B2C3
peripherals: YubiKey-Company
```
Noah: I'll ship the laptop back. Do I need to power it on for diagnostics before shipping?
IT-bot: Helpful but not required. If possible, leave device powered on and connected to Wi-Fi before shipment to allow final diagnostics. We'll still run a remote check during the wipe window.
Security: We'll run an access review and revoke org SSO credentials the morning after 2024-07-03 at 09:30 PT. Please remove any personal tokens from repos and dotfiles now. If there are service accounts Noah uses, tag @Hiring or the team that owns them for rotation.
Hiring: Heads-up — we'll need to start the replacement hiring plan. @Noah could you paste the job spec and a short note on background for candidate handoff?
Noah: Will paste job spec and link to Google doc by EOD. Also I have an outstanding intern ramping — I'll set up a 30-min transfer session the week before.
Priya (People Ops): Exit interview — would you prefer a 30-min video or 20-min quick call? We can do on 07/05 (morning) or 07/08 (afternoon).
Noah: 30-min video on 07/05 morning works.
Priya (People Ops): Scheduled — exit interview booked 2024-07-05 10:00 PT; invite sent. Final payroll & PTO payout will be processed next cycle; payroll team notified. COBRA materials and asset return instructions will be emailed within 14 business days of 07/03. Legal will draft visa letter and share the template. If urgent access issues come up, DM Security or me. Thanks, Noah.
Noah: Appreciate the support — I'll get the job spec and the handoff notes in today.
Priya (People Ops): Thank you — we'll confirm the return label in DM and the locker drop option if you decide to hand it in at SF office. :handshake:
